title: Transducer output on an initial bit
statement: For the specified bit transducer, let $q$ be a state and let $b$ be a bit, followed by a finite bit string $r$. The output on the input consisting of $b$ followed by $r$, starting in state $q$, is the concatenation of the one-bit word $b$ if $q$ is the output state (and the empty word otherwise) with the output on $r$ starting in the state reached from $q$ upon reading $b$.
hypotheses_covered: The initial state $q$ is a state of the specified transducer.
The first input symbol $b$ is a bit.
The remaining input $r$ is a finite bit string.
